quinto: quinto — fifth, the fifth part of the booty (= quinto; el quinto or la quinta, the share due by custom; d'aqueste quinto 'of this fifth')
avedes: aver — you have (2nd pl. present, -edes; perfect auxiliary with a participle, me avedes mandado 'you have granted me'; = habéis)
pagar: pagar — to pay, to satisfy (infinitive; pagar se ya 'he would be satisfied'; por pagar 'still unpaid, yet to be paid'; = pagar, pagarse)
delle: de + elle — of it, with it (elle, old form of él, Latin ille; pagar se ya delle 'would be satisfied with it'; = de él, de ello)
castellano: castellano — Castilian, of Castile (el Castellano, epithet of Alfonso as king of Castile; = castellano)
suelto: soltar — I release, let go (present 1st sg.; = suelto)
avello: aver + lo — to have it (infinitive aver with enclitic lo, rl > ll; avello quitado 'to hold it as remitted'; = haberlo; the analysis is the usual one but not certain)
quitado: quitar — remitted, waived, given up (past part., of a debt or claim; avello quitado 'to hold it remitted'; closest condonado, renunciado)
pague: pagar — (that) I be satisfied, paid (present subjunctive 1st sg., reflexive me pague; fata que yo me pague 'until I am satisfied'; = pague)
campo: campo — field, open ground, field of battle (= campo; en el campo 'in the open field'; the element in Campeador) · campo de Taranz 'the plain of Taranz'
enpleye: enplear — (that) I may employ, use (present subjunctive 1st sg.; enpleye la lança 'may I ply the lance'; = emplee)
meta: meter — (that) I put, lay (present subjunctive 1st sg.; meta mano 'lay hand to (the sword)'; = meta)
destellando: destellar — dripping, trickling (gerund; la sangre destellando 'the blood dripping'; Latin destillare; closest destilando, since modern destellar means 'to flash')
lidiador: lidiador — fighter, warrior (agent noun from lidiar; closest luchador, combatiente)
prendré: prender — I shall take (future 1st sg., syncopated; non prendré 'I shall not take'; = prenderé, closest tomaré)
ganaredes: ganar — you shall gain, win (2nd pl., -edes; future, = ganaréis, as Pidal's paraphrase has it; the same letters spell the future subjunctive ganáredes, = ganareis, hayáis ganado)
quesquier: quesquier — whatever, anything (indefinite; quesquier que sea 'whatever it may be'; no direct modern form, closest cualquier cosa, cualquiera que sea)
afelo: afé + lo — behold it, here it is (presentative afé with enclitic lo; afelo en vuestra mano 'here it is in your hand'; closest helo aquí)
juntadas: juntar — gathered, collected (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with ganançias; = juntadas)
comidiós: comedir + se — he reflected, realized (preterite 3rd sg. comidió + enclitic se, spelled -s; comidiós … que 'he thought that'; Pidal: 'se dio cuenta, reparó, pensó'; modern comedirse means 'to restrain oneself', closest pensó, reparó)
llegarién: llegar — they would arrive, come up (conditional 3rd pl., -ién; = llegarían)
compañas: compaña — company, band of troops (pl.; = compañas, closest tropas)
buscarie: buscar — he would seek (conditional 3rd sg., -ie; buscar mal 'seek to harm'; = buscaría)
mesnadas: mesnada — household troop, band of followers (pl.; = mesnadas)
quiñoneros: quiñonero — officer who divides the booty into shares (quiñones) (masc. pl.; sos quiñoneros 'his share-masters'; closest repartidores)
arribança: arribança — good fortune, prosperity (Pidal: 'buena fortuna, estado próspero'; i an arribança 'they fare well there'; no modern form, closest prosperidad, buena fortuna)
cada: cada — each, every (= cada; a cada uno 'to each one')
caden: caer — they fall (to), are due (present 3rd pl. with -d- kept; caden çient marcos 'a hundred marks fall to each'; = caen, closest les corresponden)
presentaja: presentaja — gift, present (dar en presentaja 'to give as a gift'; Pidal: 'presente, regalo') · also an offer, a price proposed (d'aquesta presentaja 'with this offer'; Pidal: 'oferta o proposición de precio'); no modern form, closest presente, oferta
cativas: cativo — captive woman, female prisoner (fem. pl.; = cautivas)
quiso: querer — he wished (strong preterite 3rd sg.; non quiso 'he did not want'; = quiso)
conprada: comprar — bought (past part. fem. sg., passive with serié; serié conprada 'it would be bought'; = comprada)
oviessen: aver — they would have (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.; aun de lo que diessen oviessen grand ganançia 'even from what they might give they would have great profit'; = hubiesen, the subject being the buyers; reading of the clause slightly uncertain)
asmaron: asmar — they estimated, valued (preterite 3rd pl.; Latin aestimare; closest tasaron, estimaron)
tercer: tercero — third (apocopated before a noun; tercer dia 'third day'; = tercer)
dados: dar — given, paid (past part. masc. pl.; dados foron 'were paid'; = dados)
foron: seer — they were (preterite 3rd pl., variant of fueron; = fueron)
asmó: asmar — he reckoned, judged (preterite 3rd sg.; closest estimó, juzgó)
avrie: aver — there would be (conditional 3rd sg., syncopated; non i avrie morada 'there would be no staying'; = habría)
morada: morada — dwelling, stay, lodging (= morada; non i avrie morada 'one could not stay there')
serie: seer — it would be (conditional 3rd sg.; = sería; same as serié)
retenedor: retenedor — that can be held, tenable (adjective from retener 'to hold'; serie retenedor 'it could be held'; no modern equivalent, closest defendible; sense inferred from the contrast mas non i avrie agua)
paz: paz — peace (= paz; moros en paz 'Moors at peace', i.e. those who have submitted)
escripta: escrivir — written (past part. fem. sg., Latin scripta; escripta es la carta 'the charter is written'; = escrita)
buscar: buscar — to seek (infinitive; buscar nos verná 'he will come to seek us'; buscar nos ie 'he would seek us', infinitive + clitic + auxiliary, split future/conditional; = buscar)
ie: aver — would (reduced imperfect of aver, 3rd sg., as conditional ending after an infinitive with clitic; buscar nos ie 'he would seek us' = nos buscaría; = -ía)
escuelas: escuela — household troops, retinue (pl.; oid, escuelas 'hear, my men'; Pidal: = mesnadas; not modern 'school'; closest mesnadas, tropas)
dixiero: dezir — I shall say (future subjunctive 1st sg., archaic -iero; lo que yo dixiero 'whatever I say'; = dijere, a tense now obsolete)
tengades: tener — (that) you hold (present subjunctive 2nd pl., -ades; non lo tengades a mal 'do not take it ill', prohibition; = tengáis)
podriemos: poder — we could (conditional 1st pl., syncopated -iemos; = podríamos)
fincar: fincar — to stay, remain (infinitive; = quedarse, closest quedar)
verná: venir — he will come (future 3rd sg., syncopated; buscar nos verná 'he will come to seek us'; = vendrá)
hermar: hermar — to leave desolate, lay waste (infinitive, from yermo 'empty, desert'; = yermar, closest dejar yermo, despoblar)
pris: prender — I took (short strong preterite 1st sg.; lo pris dellos 'I took it from them'; = prendí, closest tomé)
digan: dezir — (that) they say (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; que de mí non digan mal 'so that they may not speak ill of me'; = digan)
pagados: pagar — paid, satisfied (past part. masc. pl.; todos sodes pagados 'you are all satisfied'; = pagados)
cras: cras — tomorrow (adverb, Latin cras; cras a la mañana 'tomorrow morning'; modern uses mañana)
lidiar: lidiar — to fight (infinitive; = lidiar, closest luchar)
plaz: plazer — it pleases (present 3rd sg., apocopated; a todos plaz 'it pleases all'; = place, closest agrada)
prisieron: prender — they took (strong preterite 3rd pl.; del castiello que prisieron 'of the castle they took'; = prendieron, closest tomaron)
bendiziéndol: bendezir + le — blessing him (gerund + enclitic le, e elided; bendiziéndol están 'they are blessing him'; = bendiciéndole)
troçen: troçir — they cross, pass through (present 3rd pl.; troçen las Alcarrias 'they cross the Alcarria'; no direct modern form, closest atraviesan, traspasan)
alcarrias: Alcarria — the Alcarria, upland region of Guadalajara province (pl., las Alcarrias; = la Alcarria; traditional identification)
cuevas: cueva — cave (pl.; = cuevas; las Cuevas, first element of the place name las Cuevas d'Anquita)
anquita: Anquita — Anguita, village in Guadalajara province (las Cuevas d'Anquita; traditional identification, the Cuevas de Anguita)
passaron: passar — they passed, crossed (preterite 3rd pl.; = pasaron)
aguas: agua — water, stream (pl.; passaron las aguas 'they crossed the waters', i.e. the streams; = aguas)
taranz: Taranz — campo de Taranz, part of the plateau dividing the waters of the Tajuña and the Jalón, on the border of the provinces of Guadalajara and Soria (Pidal)
fariza: Fariza — a place on the route into the Jalón region, usually identified with Ariza (Zaragoza province); identification traditional, f- is the poem's spelling
çetina: Çetina — Cetina, place in Zaragoza province (= Cetina; traditional identification)
albergar: albergar — to lodge, halt for the night (infinitive; iva albergar 'went to lodge', i.e. lodged; = albergar, closest alojarse, acampar)
ardiment: ardiment — boldness, daring; a bold design (apocopated -ment; = ardimiento, closest audacia, designio)
moviós: mover + se — he set out, moved off (preterite 3rd sg. movió + enclitic se, spelled -s; = se movió, closest se puso en marcha)
alfama: Alfama — a place on the route, usually identified with Alhama (de Aragón, Zaragoza province); identification traditional
foz: foz — gorge, narrow river valley (Latin faucem; = hoz; la Foz may be a place name or the gorge itself, reading uncertain)
bovierca: Bovierca — Bubierca, place in Zaragoza province (traditional identification)
teca: Teca — Ateca, place in Zaragoza province (traditional identification)
alcoçer: Alcoçer — Alcocer, a Moorish town the Cid camps before; site now unknown (Pidal: on the left of the Jalón, between Ateca and Calatayud)
corre: correr — it runs, flows (present 3rd sg.; = corre)
salón: Salón — the river Jalón (the old form of the name; = Jalón)
puedent: poder — they can (present 3rd pl., the old plural -nt kept in the spelling; agua nol puedent vedar 'they cannot cut off his water'; = pueden)
vedar: vedar — to forbid, prevent, cut off (infinitive; agua … vedar 'to deny water'; Latin vetare; closest prohibir, impedir)
cueda: cuedar — he thinks, expects (present 3rd sg., variant of cuidar; cueda ganar 'he expects to take'; closest cuida, piensa)

__broaden__.mandado: mandado — message, news, word (noun; from mandar 'to send, order') · also mandado — order, command (mandado de so señor 'the lord's command'); fazer mandado 'to send word' · also past part. 'granted, assigned' (el quinto que me avedes mandado 'the fifth you have granted me')
__broaden__.gelos: ge + los — them to him (ge, ancestor of modern se, + los; = se los) · also ge = 'to them' (que gelos diessen 'that they should give them to them', the knights)
__broaden__.partir: partir — to part, separate (infinitive; partir nos emos 'we shall part') · also 'to divide, apportion' (partir tod aqueste aver 'to divide all this wealth')
__broaden__.están: estar — they are, stay (present 3rd pl.; = están) · also progressive auxiliary with a gerund (bendiziéndol están 'they are blessing him')
__broaden__.ganar: ganar — to gain, earn · also 'to capture, take (a fortress)' (Alcoçer cueda ganar 'he expects to take Alcocer')
__broaden__.al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least' · also a + el standing for a + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (al espada = a la espada)
__broaden__.de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me')
__broaden__.por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly' · also 'for (a price)' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'by means of' (por carta 'by writ'); 'through, thanks to' (por mí ganaredes 'through me you will gain')
__broaden__.quanto: quanto — as much as, whatever (= cuanto) · quanto ella mejor sabe 'as best she can' (quanto + comparative 'as much as') · also 'how much' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'as far/fast as' (quanto pueden andar)
__broaden__.a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight' · also a — 'into' (sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'); 'at, in' (a la çaga 'at the rear'); 'against' (dar salto a la çaga); dative 'to' (a mí dedes); haber a + inf. 'have to' (lo han a far); a + noun of direction (adeliñava a la puerta 'made for the gate') · impersonal 'there is' (aver; es dia a de plazo 'there is (only) a day of the term', the most likely reading of a hard line); ha as auxiliary set after the participle (soñado a 'he has dreamt') · also 'on, at (a time)' (a tercer dia 'on the third day')
__broaden__.me: me — me, to me · also reflexive 'myself' (fata que yo me pague 'until I am satisfied')
__broaden__.van: ir — they go (present 3rd pl.) · also ir + gerund 'keep going' (passando van 'they go on passing')
__broaden__.los: el — the (masc. pl.); them (object pronoun) · also los que 'those who' (demonstrative use before a relative); los — him, them as object of consejar (commo los consejava 'as he advised them') · also los de 'those of' (con los de Castejón 'with the men of Castejón')
__broaden__.ya: ya — O! (vocative particle, Arabic yā); also 'now, already' · also ya — 'would', reduced imperfect of aver as conditional ending, 3rd sg., after infinitive + clitic (pagar se ya 'would be satisfied'; = -ía)
__broaden__.fincava: fincar — he planted, pitched (imperfect) · also 'it remained, stayed' (imperfect 3rd sg.; todo el quinto a mio Çid fincava 'the whole fifth stayed with my Cid'; = quedaba)
__broaden__.quitar: quitar — to leave, quit (infinitive; el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'; = quitar, closest abandonar) · also 'to set free' (quiero las i quitar 'I mean to free them there'; Pidal: 'libertar')
__broaden__.carta: carta — letter, written decree · also 'written deed, charter' (escripta es la carta 'the charter (of peace) is written'; por carta 'in writing')
__broaden__.aun: aun — even, besides · also aun — yet, still (aun vea el dia 'may I yet see the day') · also 'even though' (= aunque; aun de lo que diessen oviessen grand ganançia, Pidal's reading)
__broaden__.sobre: sobre — upon, over; here 'on the security of' (sobre aquellas arcas) · sobre Navas de Palos 'above, hard by Navas de Palos' (position along the route) · also 'before, against (a town to be besieged)' (sobre Alcoçer iva posar 'went to camp before Alcocer')
__broaden__.otro: otro — other, another (masc.; el otro 'the other'; = otro) · also otro día 'the next day'; lo otro 'the rest'
